row.notes: Vehicle table variant of the slot free: before freeing the record through the slot allocator it clears the qword at record+0x880 (element count of an inline array, so no element dtors run). Pops the vector if the slot is last, else nulls it. Returns 1 if a record was present. Independent re-check (lab blind verifier 2026-11-27): partial, better name Ent_SlotTable_FreeSlotByIndex_ClearBackRef: Bounds-checks ushort param_2 against a 16-byte-entry vector at param_1+8, pops the tail or nulls entry+8, clears obj+0x880 and calls vtable+0x38 on the stored pointer, returning 1 or 0; the code gives no basis for vehicle (vs team) beyond the +0x880 back-reference.
